localeRegistry.notes: Defines tag, name, nativeName, direction, isActive, fallbackTag, but lacks lifecycle status enum (REGISTERED, TRANSLATION_IN_PROGRESS, QA_REQUIRED, PRODUCTION_READY, DISABLED).

localeValidation.notes: Validates bundle structural integrity, BCP-47 tag conformance, and key coverage.

localeResolution.notes: Strict 5-tier resolution (Explicit Choice -> Account Saved -> Guest Session -> First Run Suggestion -> Platform Default) with deep-frozen provenance.

serverLocale.notes: Resolves locale from rentipid_locale and rentipid_pref cookies during SSR. Does not query database if cookies are stripped.

clientLocale.notes: Client React Context bound to activeLocale state, synchronized with cookies, DOM attributes, and custom events.

translationKeyContract.notes: Defines 445 canonical keys across 11 namespaces, but 14 major application domains remain absent.

translationBundles.notes: Full key parity (445/445), but statically imported into memory at boot time without lazy loading.

fallback.notes: Deterministic 4-step resolution: Exact locale -> Family fallback -> Platform default (en-PH) -> Humanized title-case string (never raw dot keys).

preferencePersistence.notes: Prisma-backed atomic upsert on UserGlobalPreference with version-based optimistic concurrency control.

cookiePersistence.notes: Tamper-evident HMAC-SHA256 cookie bounded under 256 bytes with strict security key prohibitions.

accountPreference.notes: Enforces strict authorization: actor user ID must match target user ID.

langAttribute.notes: Server-injected on SSR RootLayout and updated dynamically by client context on switch.

textDirection.notes: Pure resolution returning 'ltr' | 'rtl' based on locale metadata and bundle specification.

globalPreferencesUi.notes: Accessible dialog with tabbed navigation, live search filters, draft preview formatting, and conflict detection.

staticUiVsDynamicContent.justification: Static UI translation handles immutable software strings with dictionary parity; dynamic content service handles user-generated content with SHA-256 hash invalidation and PII sanitization.

serverVsClientTranslators.justification: Next.js App Router Server Components cannot access client React context or DOM; server translation bound to cookies is architectural requirement.

clientSingletonVsContextHook.justification: 19 client files directly invoke static singleton t() which does not trigger React re-renders on locale change without a page reload.

copyProxy.justification: Created for GlobalPreferencesModal convenience; wraps t() calls with getters.
